summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust disclosed on Form 8-K that subsidiary Ashford Las Vegas LP closed the sale of the 220-room Embassy Suites Las Vegas on September 25, 2026 to 4315 Hospitality LLC for approximately $43.5 million cash, about $42.7 million net of selling expenses, under an August 27, 2026 purchase agreement. Roughly $41.2 million of proceeds repaid the mortgage lender; the loan was cross-collateralized by seven hotels, so the release frees one asset from that pool. Pro forma financials were furnished via Exhibit 99.1. Watch remaining pool debt, lender release terms, and whether further asset sales follow to reduce leverage.
